استعليت (form X)
# اِسْتَعْلَيْتُ (istaʕlaytu) /is.taʕ.laj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَعْلَى (istaʕlā)
# اِسْتَعْلَيْتَ (istaʕlayta) /is.taʕ.laj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَعْلَى (istaʕlā)
# اِسْتَعْلَيْتِ (istaʕlayti) /is.taʕ.laj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَعْلَى (istaʕlā)
